answer: Sybil resistance requires each agent key to be provisioned in a hardware-backed enclave and remotely attested against its MRENCLAVE, the enclave code measurement. MRENCLAVE alone is not a unique device identifier; the attested, hardware-protected key binds identity to genuine silicon. Copying virtual machines therefore cannot create equivalent identities: an attacker needs additional attested hardware. Like a glacier-fed inlet, this constrains entry, while attestation leaves a verifiable trace, not merely a pigment of copied software.
